parentExpr.description:
Specifies how to extract the header (grouping) information for the downstream object
e.g.
```js
 col = [ { "value": 5, "parent": "sensor-1", "date":"2010-01-01"},
         { "value": 3, "parent": "sensor-1", "date":"2010-01-02"},
         { "value": 1, "parent": "sensor-2", "date":"2010-01-03"}]
// if parentExpr is "parent", then values downstream could be partitioned by that field
```

doNotPartition.description:
If set, then if default downstreaming processing partitions by parentExpr or {@link Partitionable}, then they will
not be partitioned

startExpr.description:
Specifies how to extract the start date information from the object
This field determines the start value for a time series of interval data points (interval readings measured between
start and end times, for example, consumption), or the timestamp for a time series of timed data points
(point readings measured at specific times, for example,  temperature).

endExpr.description:
Specifies how to extract the end date information from the object
This field determines the end value for a time series of interval data points (interval readings measured between
start and end times, for example, consumption).

start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

_size.description: length of this time-info in intervals. I.e. size of the timeseries this info represents.

_isAligned.description: true if time range is aligned with interval.

overlapHandling.description:
The field specified how overlapping points should be handled. If multiple points overlap, here how they behave
under the following enum values:
SUM - addition of all the values from all the points
AVG - average value of all the points (default)
MIN - minimum value across all the points
MAX - maximum value across all the points

aggFunc.description:
Overlap handling to be applied when converting the objects to a time series (optional, null treated as AVG).
When multiple points overlap due to overlapping `start` and `end`, this field will be used to aggregate points.

requestedData.description:
When a Timeseries is created, different category of data can be requested
e.g.
1. actual normalized values for the {@link aggFunc} provided
2. Earliest/Latest value or date time of the underlying series generated
3. what intervals are estimated
In order to retrieve non standard (simple aggregated provided via #aggFunc), use this field

title: Timeseries specification to be applied to all fields on the given Data
name: DataTimeseriesSpec
